description: Versioned Computer Science Shared Taxonomy covering DSA, DBMS, OS, Computer Networks, and System Design.

nodes.name: Data Structures and Algorithms
nodes.description: Core computer science data structures, storage abstractions, and algorithmic problem-solving paradigms.

nodes.name: Arrays and Strings
nodes.description: Linear contiguous memory structures, character sequences, indexing, and array manipulation algorithms.

nodes.name: Two Pointers Technique
nodes.description: Searching pairs or subarrays in linear structures using converging or fast-slow pointer iterations.

nodes.name: Sliding Window Technique
nodes.description: Maintaining dynamic or fixed-size contiguous subarray windows to solve range and substring optimization problems.

nodes.name: Prefix Sum
nodes.description: Precomputing cumulative sum arrays to perform constant-time range sum queries.

nodes.name: Linked Lists
nodes.description: Singly and doubly linked pointer-based node sequences, insertions, deletions, and list operations.

nodes.name: Linked List Manipulation & Cycle Detection
nodes.description: Reversing linked list pointers, merging sorted lists, finding middle nodes, and Floyd's cycle-finding algorithm.

nodes.name: Stacks and Queues
nodes.description: LIFO stack and FIFO queue abstract data types, implementation variants, and sequence evaluation.

nodes.name: Monotonic Stack and Queue
nodes.description: Maintaining elements in strictly increasing or decreasing order inside stacks/queues to find next greater or smaller elements.

nodes.name: Trees and Binary Trees
nodes.description: Hierarchical node data structures, binary trees, balanced trees, and recursive tree traversals.

nodes.name: Tree Traversals
nodes.description: Visiting tree nodes using preorder, inorder, postorder, and level-order breadth-first traversals.

nodes.name: Binary Search Trees
nodes.description: Ordered binary search trees, insertion, deletion, searching, and maintaining BST invariants.

nodes.name: Lowest Common Ancestor
nodes.description: Finding the lowest shared ancestor node of two target nodes in binary trees and binary search trees.

nodes.name: Heaps and Priority Queues
nodes.description: Min-heaps, max-heaps, priority queues, binary heap representations, and heapify operations.

nodes.name: Top K Elements and K-Way Merge
nodes.description: Using min/max priority queues to efficiently track top K frequent elements and merge K sorted streams.

nodes.name: Graphs and Network Topologies
nodes.description: Vertices, edges, directed/undirected graphs, adjacency representations, and graph algorithms.

nodes.name: Graph Traversal (BFS & DFS)
nodes.description: Exploring graphs using queue-based Breadth-First Search and recursive or stack-based Depth-First Search.

nodes.name: Shortest Path Algorithms
nodes.description: Computing single-source and all-pairs shortest paths using Dijkstra's, Bellman-Ford, and Floyd-Warshall algorithms.

nodes.name: Topological Sorting
nodes.description: Ordering vertices in Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) using Kahn's algorithm or DFS for dependency resolution.

nodes.name: Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find)
nodes.description: Managing partitioned sets using Union-Find with path compression and rank-based union for connectivity.

nodes.name: Sorting and Searching
nodes.description: Comparison and non-comparison sorting techniques, linear search, and binary search methodologies.

nodes.name: Binary Search
nodes.description: Logarithmic search on sorted arrays, rotated arrays, and binary search on monotonic answer spaces.

nodes.name: Dynamic Programming
nodes.description: Optimization via overlapping subproblems, optimal substructure, memoization, and tabular state transitions.

nodes.name: 1D Dynamic Programming
nodes.description: Solving linear recurrence state transitions including Fibonacci variants, house robber, and climbing stairs.

nodes.name: Knapsack and Subset DP
nodes.description: 0/1 Knapsack, unbounded knapsack, coin change, and subset sum optimization problems.

nodes.name: Grid Path Dynamic Programming
nodes.description: Finding minimum path sums and unique traversal paths across 2D grid matrices.

nodes.name: String and Subsequence DP
nodes.description: Longest Common Subsequence, Edit Distance, and String Alignment dynamic programming algorithms.

nodes.name: Recursion and Backtracking
nodes.description: Exploring state space trees recursively, pruning invalid branches, and generating combinatorial structures.

nodes.name: Subsets and Permutations
nodes.description: Generating power sets, permutations, combinations, and solving constraint satisfaction problems.

nodes.name: Database Management Systems
nodes.description: Database architectures, data modeling, relational algebra, SQL querying, transactions, and indexing.

nodes.name: Relational Model and ER Diagrams
nodes.description: Entities, relationships, keys (primary, foreign), and relational schema design.

nodes.name: Structured Query Language (SQL)
nodes.description: Data Definition Language (DDL), Data Manipulation Language (DML), and complex relational queries.

nodes.name: SQL Aggregations and Grouping
nodes.description: Filtering, grouping, HAVING clauses, and aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX).

nodes.name: SQL Joins
nodes.description: Combining rows from multiple relational tables using INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL JOIN, and self joins.

nodes.name: SQL Subqueries and Window Functions
nodes.description: Nested subqueries, correlated subqueries, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), and window ranking functions.

nodes.name: Database Normalization
nodes.description: Functional dependencies, eliminating data redundancy, and database normal forms.

nodes.name: Normal Forms (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF)
nodes.description: Decomposing tables to satisfy First, Second, Third, and Boyce-Codd Normal Forms.

nodes.name: Transactions and Concurrency Control
nodes.description: Database transaction management, ACID properties, schedule serializability, and concurrency control.

nodes.name: ACID Properties
nodes.description: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability guarantees in transactional databases.

nodes.name: Transaction Isolation and Locking
nodes.description: Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable isolation levels, 2-Phase Locking (2PL), and deadlock resolution.

nodes.name: Database Indexing and Storage
nodes.description: Disk storage organization, page layouts, file structures, and database index mechanisms.

nodes.name: B-Trees and B+ Tree Indexing
nodes.description: Clustered and non-clustered indexes implemented using balanced B-Tree and B+ Tree structures.

nodes.name: NoSQL Databases
nodes.description: Non-relational data models including Key-Value, Document, Wide-Column, and Graph store architectures.

nodes.name: Operating Systems
nodes.description: Operating system kernel architecture, process management, memory management, file systems, and hardware abstractions.

nodes.name: Processes and Threads
nodes.description: Process state transitions, process control blocks, execution threads, and user-space vs kernel-space execution.

nodes.name: Context Switching and Process Control Block
nodes.description: Register state saving, process control block (PCB) metadata, and context switch CPU overhead.

nodes.name: Multithreading and User/Kernel Threads
nodes.description: Thread execution models, POSIX threads, race conditions, and user-level vs kernel-level thread mapping.

nodes.name: CPU Scheduling
nodes.description: Processor allocation strategies, scheduling queues, preemptive and non-preemptive scheduling algorithms.

nodes.name: CPU Scheduling Algorithms
nodes.description: First-Come First-Served (FCFS), Shortest Job First (SJF), Round Robin (RR), and Priority Scheduling.

nodes.name: Process Synchronization and IPC
nodes.description: Inter-process communication, critical section problem, mutual exclusion, and synchronization primitives.

nodes.name: Semaphores, Mutexes, and Monitors
nodes.description: Mutex locks, counting semaphores, monitors, and classic concurrency problems (Producer-Consumer, Dining Philosophers).

nodes.name: Memory Management and Virtual Memory
nodes.description: Main memory allocation, contiguous memory, paging, segmentation, and virtual memory systems.

nodes.name: Paging, TLB, and Segmentation
nodes.description: Logical to physical address translation, page tables, Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB), and memory segmentation.

nodes.name: Demand Paging and Page Replacement
nodes.description: Page fault handling, thrashing, and page replacement algorithms (FIFO, LRU, Optimal, Clock).

nodes.name: Deadlocks
nodes.description: Necessary conditions for deadlock, resource allocation graphs, and handling strategies.

nodes.name: Deadlock Prevention and Banker's Algorithm
nodes.description: Breaking Coffman conditions, Banker's safety algorithm, deadlock detection, and recovery mechanisms.

nodes.name: File Systems
nodes.description: File concepts, directory organization, disk block allocation strategies, and inode structures.

nodes.name: Computer Networks
nodes.description: Data communications, layered network architectures, Internet protocol stack, and network security.

nodes.name: Network Architecture Models
nodes.description: OSI 7-layer model, TCP/IP protocol stack, encapsulation, and packet headers.

nodes.name: OSI Model and TCP/IP Layers
nodes.description: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, and Application layers and protocol mapping.

nodes.name: Application Layer Protocols
nodes.description: Client-server architecture, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, FTP, SMTP, and application data exchange.

nodes.name: HTTP, HTTPS, and REST
nodes.description: HTTP request/response methods, status codes, headers, RESTful API conventions, and HTTPS security.

nodes.name: Domain Name System (DNS)
nodes.description: DNS hierarchy, recursive/iterative domain resolution, record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT), and DNS caching.

nodes.name: Transport Layer Protocols
nodes.description: End-to-end communication, port addressing, multiplexing, TCP, and UDP transport mechanisms.

nodes.name: TCP vs UDP Protocols
nodes.description: Connection-oriented reliable TCP vs connectionless lightweight UDP trade-offs and packet headers.

nodes.name: TCP Handshake, Flow, and Congestion Control
nodes.description: TCP 3-way handshake, 4-way teardown, sliding window flow control, and slow-start congestion control.

nodes.name: Network Layer and Routing
nodes.description: Logical IP addressing, subnetting, packet forwarding, and routing algorithms.

nodes.name: IP Addressing, Subnetting, and CIDR
nodes.description: IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnet masks, Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR), and NAT.

nodes.name: Routing Algorithms and Protocols
nodes.description: Distance-vector (RIP) and Link-state (OSPF) routing algorithms, BGP, and autonomous systems.

nodes.name: Network Security Fundamentals
nodes.description: Symmetric/asymmetric encryption, digital signatures, SSL/TLS, firewalls, and network threats.

nodes.name: TLS/SSL Handshake and Encryption
nodes.description: TLS handshake protocol, public-key certificates, symmetric session key exchange, and transport encryption.

nodes.name: System Design
nodes.description: Large-scale distributed systems design, high availability, fault tolerance, scalability, and architectural components.

nodes.name: Scalability and System Architectures
nodes.description: Monolithic vs microservices architectures, horizontal and vertical scaling, and back-of-the-envelope estimations.

nodes.name: Load Balancing
nodes.description: Traffic distribution, Layer 4 vs Layer 7 load balancing, health checking, and reverse proxies.

nodes.name: Load Balancing Algorithms & Consistent Hashing
nodes.description: Round Robin, Weighted Least Connections, and Consistent Hashing for server distribution.

nodes.name: Caching Strategies and CDNs
nodes.description: In-memory caching, distributed caches (Redis, Memcached), cache policies, and Content Delivery Networks.

nodes.name: Cache Invalidation & Eviction Strategies
nodes.description: Cache-Aside, Write-Through, Write-Back caching patterns, LRU/LFU eviction, and cache stampede prevention.

nodes.name: Database Scaling and Partitioning
nodes.description: Scaling databases beyond single node capacity through replication, federation, and partitioning.

nodes.name: Database Sharding and Read Replicas
nodes.description: Horizontal database sharding keys, primary-replica replication, read scaling, and split-brain scenarios.

nodes.name: Message Queues and Event-Driven Architecture
nodes.description: Asynchronous task processing, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), publish-subscribe, and event streaming.

nodes.name: Message Queue Patterns and Decoupling
nodes.description: Point-to-point queues, publish-subscribe topics, message ordering, idempotent consumer processing, and dead-letter queues.

nodes.name: Distributed Systems Trade-offs & CAP Theorem
nodes.description: Consistency, Availability, Partition Tolerance trade-offs, PACELC theorem, and leader election.

nodes.name: Rate Limiting and API Gateways
nodes.description: Throttling incoming requests using Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket, Sliding Window Log algorithms, and API gateway routing.
